note: Space marine, side view, facing right (image right). Brown hair, ear and face are head; chin y~380 at the right, hair strands hanging down behind the ear to y~420-430 over the collar on the left. Dark neck collar, chest plate with the blue screen, belly plates, belt (y~570-610), hip plates and the maroon cape hanging behind on the left (x222-390, y490-764) are torso; a small maroon piece beside the right hand (x596-656, y676-728) and a cape bit between the legs (x462-497, y696-745) are also torso. Hip = belt bottom y~612. Arms hang straight, one swung back (image left) and one forward (image right); near and far are not distinguishable. Left arm: the big pale pauldron (with orange decal), the strap band and the dark suit sleeve are upper arm (shoulder y~396); the elbow is where the dark sleeve meets the pale bracer plate (y~540); the bracer plate is forearm, wrist y~603; the dark rounded gauntlet below it (y~603-676) is the hand. Right arm: thin pale pauldron plate and dark sleeve are upper arm (shoulder y~408), elbow y~540 at the top of the pale bracer plate, which is forearm; wrist y~603; the dark rounded gauntlet (y~603-676) and the pink fingertips below it (x~633-645, y~680-712) are hand. Thighs are the pale thigh armour from y~612 to the knee pads; knee pads are lower leg, so the knee is at the pad tops (left y~700, right y~705); greaves are lower leg; ankles at the top of the boot foot (y~815 both sides). Feet: left boot bulges left, right boot points right.
